description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Direction No. 54 - Directing all Manufacturers and Traders of items such as Ata Pirikara etc. Shall register their institutions with the Department of Buddhist Affairs and display the Certificate w.e.f. 01.11.2015
reasoning: This gazette contains a special direction issued under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003, which establishes a regulatory requirement for manufacturers and traders to register with and display certificates from the Department of Buddhist Affairs. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5).
